output.disambiguation: validate_cbr_data_return validates an AGGREGATE periodic data return against an illustrative profile-driven template. Per-message ISO 20022 address linting lives in lint_cbpr_structured_address (art-241) and per-message LEI/transparency linting in lint_lei_payment_binding (art-246); this node accepts only their aggregate summaries as input values and never reimplements their rules. This template is illustrative and is not any official project data collection template or resilience index.
output.pii_note: Aggregate-only return: counts, sums, currency codes, country codes, period dates and enumerated institution types. Institutions appear only as profile-local pseudonymous codes (FI-NNN form). No customer, counterparty, correspondent or institution names, BIC, LEI or account identifiers are accepted; any string leaf outside the enumerations is refused by JSON path with the value never echoed. Use synthetic or anonymised data only.
